questions.question: Dr. Meriem returns to her practice after 14 weeks of maternity leave. She discovers that her replacement, Dr. Karim, has modified some protocols. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
options: Analyze the changes and discuss with Dr. Karim
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, take the time to analyze the changes. Discuss with Karim, some adjustments may be beneficial.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem finds that 15% of her patients left during her leave. Dr. Sofia explains that this is a common situation. She recommends that she:
options: Lower her prices to bring them back
Contact the patients who left to understand why
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, contact the patients who left to understand why. Some left out of loyalty to the replacement, others for practical reasons. This feedback is valuable.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem discovers that Dr. Karim increased some fees during her absence. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, if the increases are justified by inflation or rising costs, keep them. This is an opportunity to value your work.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem is exhausted by difficult nights with her baby. Dr. Sofia suggests that she:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, adjust your schedule. Start later, plan breaks, and don't hesitate to delegate certain tasks to Nadia.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders about breastfeeding in her schedule. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, schedule dedicated times to express milk. Inform your assistant and patients to avoid interruptions.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem discovers that Dr. Karim hired an assistant, Nadia, without her consent. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
options: Validate the hiring if Nadia is competent
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, if Nadia is competent and fits in well, validate her hiring. She can be an asset to your practice. But make sure her contract is compliant.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem struggles with fatigue and stress. Dr. Sofia suggests that she:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, breathing exercises, meditation, or yoga can help you manage stress. Even 10 minutes a day makes a difference.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to retain her patients after her leave. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
options: Send a thank-you message to her patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, a personalized message thanking your patients for their loyalty strengthens the bond of trust. It's a simple but powerful gesture.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem feels overwhelmed by administrative tasks. Dr. Sofia suggests that she:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, delegate some administrative tasks to Nadia. She can manage files, appointments, and invoices.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem discovers that Dr. Karim changed the practice organization. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, adopt changes that improve the practice's efficiency. Don't hesitate to ask your team for their opinion.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem worries about the impact of her return on her baby. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, a gradual transition allows you and your baby to adapt smoothly. Start with half-days.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem has a patient who refuses to be treated by a replacement. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
options: Explain the situation and reassure the patient
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, reassure your patient. Explain that her follow-up is assured and that the quality of care remains the same.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to modernize her practice. Dr. Sofia suggests that she:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, practice management software can help you save time on administration and better organize your practice.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem struggles to set boundaries with her patients. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
options: Learn to say no with kindness
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, knowing how to say no is essential to preserve your energy. Offer alternatives when possible.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wonders about the long-term future of her practice. Dr. Sofia suggests that she:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, define your 5-year goals. Do you want to expand your practice, specialize, or train replacements? A plan will give you a clear direction.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to reduce her working hours to spend more time with family. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, working 4 days a week is a viable option. Adjust your schedule and communicate clearly with your patients.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem finds that her assistant Nadia has potential but lacks training. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, investing in Nadia's training benefits both her and your practice. A trained assistant is a valuable asset.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem struggles to balance clinical care and practice management. Dr. Sofia suggests that she:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, delegate practice management to Nadia. She can handle appointments, supplies, and invoices.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to improve communication with her patients. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, a monthly newsletter on dental care, innovations, and tips strengthens your relationship with patients.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem feels overwhelmed by her replacement's demands. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, set clear boundaries with Karim. The transition should go smoothly but your decisions must be respected.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to develop her professional network. Dr. Sofia suggests that she:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, women dentists' associations offer support, advice, and development opportunities. Don't hesitate to get involved.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem struggles to manage emergencies outside working hours. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, define on-call hours for emergencies. This allows you to preserve your personal life while ensuring continuity of care.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to hire a second dentist. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, before hiring, assess the real needs of your practice. Analyze the workload and development prospects.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem has conflicts with her assistant Nadia. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
options: Organize a meeting to clarify expectations
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, communication is key. Organize a meeting with Nadia to clarify expectations and resolve misunderstandings.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem wishes to prepare her long-term succession. Dr. Sofia advises her to:
options: Identify a potential successor and train them
questions.explanation: Dr. Sofia: 'Meriem, identifying and training a potential successor allows you to prepare for the future with peace of mind.'

questions.question: Dr. Meriem, at the end of their conversation, says: 'Sofia, I feel ready to face these challenges.' Sofia replies that the return is a key step. Meriem concludes:
options: The return is an opportunity for growth
The return is a waste of time
questions.explanation: Meriem: 'Sofia, I feel ready to face these challenges.' Sofia: 'Meriem, the return is an opportunity for growth, both personal and professional. You have all the skills to succeed.'
